title: $256,000 For Nothing
why_movie: RESULT: a royalty deal that paid $450 million in sales, $180 million in the first 18 months, with his own biggest single-week check at $256,000 (money is not empty). METHOD: he says he sat down, decided exactly what to manifest with his mind, and told the universe to figure it out. WISH: a stranger stuck trading hours for a paycheck would want the 14 audios because this is the exact ask-and-receive method, literal and checkable - he asked for a check he never had to work for, and that is exactly what showed up.

caption:
Comment "WISH" and I'll send you Kevin Trudeau's 14 Your Wish Is Your Command audios. Free.

Kevin Trudeau says that back in the early 1980s he sat down and decided exactly what he wanted: $50,000 a week, no job, no boss, just a check in the mail.

A month later in New York, two people he barely knew - a stranger at a deli counter and an old friend's phone message - told him the same thing on the same day: put your memory course on TV.

He signed with one of them. They shot the show in a small town in Iowa. What came back in the mail every week after that is the part you have to hear him say.

{episode}

The 14 audios are Kevin teaching how to use your mind to get what you want in life. They were recorded live at a private event in the Alps.

Most people will watch this and scroll on. A few will comment "WISH" and start listening tonight.

No message within a minute? Look in your message requests, or use the link in my bio.

#kevintrudeau #megamemory #manifestation #mindset #yourwishisyourcommand #lawofattraction
